Package hadur117.core.duel

Class PowerDesign

java.lang.Object
hadur117.core.duel.PowerDesign
final class PowerDesign extends Object
Duel-side switches for gun-power experiments; off by default, read by DuelController only.

  • Field Summary

    Fields
    Modifier and Type
    Field
    Description
    (package private) static final boolean
    PRESSURE
    POW-12 pressure power: while PowerPolicy.pressure holds in a duel, the gun skips the cubic power-down and fires a base power of 2.5 beyond 150 px.
    (package private) static final boolean
    PRESSURE_ALWAYS
    POW-12, gate variant "pwall" (meant with PRESSURE): no rate gate at all; pressure power on every duel aim, keeping only the energy floor and the yield to the lead-aware regime.
    (package private) static final boolean
    PRESSURE_BASE_ONLY_POWERDOWN
    POW-12, weaker form (meant with PRESSURE): under the same gate only the power-down is skipped and the base power stays 1.95.
    (package private) static final boolean
    PRESSURE_CENTRES
    POW-12, gate variant "pwc" (meant with PRESSURE): the gate reads the window centres only (ours at least 12%, theirs at most 9%, both windows holding at least 30 outcomes), no margins.
